notes: Hospitality is one segment of a mainly real estate developer; no hotel performance metrics or fee terms are in the evidence.

lodging_operating_format.value: Resort and select-service hotels (inns, resorts, branded Hilton-flag hotels) in Northwest Florida, developed within Watersound communities

room_inventory_ownership_scope.value: Portfolio of owned hotels and resorts along the Northwest Florida Gulf Coast, from a 67-room inn to several newly opened hotels

ownership_management_franchising.value: Developer-owned hotels built with company capital, some under Hilton franchise brands (Embassy Suites, Hotel Indigo, Home2 Suites) and own-branded inns

hotel_demand_seasonality.value: Gulf Coast leisure and beach-vacation demand, plus weddings and events driving hotel utilization

brand_fee_contract_economics_asset_light.value: Hotels are owned by the company rather than operated as an asset-light fee business
